name: MinerU
description: Turn complex papers and reports into structured content, including text, tables, and formulas.
provenance: Page and region information
limits: Check reading order in two-column pages, cross-page table boundaries, and the current code and model terms.

name: Docling
description: Convert PDF and Office files into a consistent document model for retrieval and data workflows.
provenance: Page and region provenance in the document model
limits: The structured document model carries richer provenance than a plain Markdown export. Test your exact export path.

name: PaddleOCR
description: Recognize text in scanned pages, with document pipelines for layout, tables, and structured output.
provenance: Page and region information; pipeline-dependent
limits: Basic OCR and document-structure pipelines produce different results. Select table and formula modules explicitly.

name: Camelot
description: Extract PDF tables into data frames and machine-readable tables for analysis.
provenance: Page and table-region information
limits: Validate merged cells, footnotes, and borderless tables. Confirm text-layer or OCR requirements for your chosen backend.

name: Amazon Textract
description: Extract text, form fields, and table cells from document images through a managed API.
provenance: Page and bounding-box information
limits: Synchronous and asynchronous operations have different limits. Verify supported languages and page quotas before a batch run.

name: ColPali
description: Encode document page images as multi-vectors and retrieve visual pages with text queries.
provenance: Page mapping must be maintained by the application
limits: This is a retrieval component. You still need an index, page identifiers, and a model or application that produces answers.

name: RAGFlow
description: Connect document parsing, chunking, and retrieval to build answers with source references.
provenance: Depends on the parser and retrieval setup
limits: Evaluate retrieval coverage and citation accuracy separately. External model services add their own costs.

name: MarkItDown
description: Convert Office files, PDFs, and other formats into Markdown for text processing and indexing.
provenance: No default region coordinates
limits: The output emphasizes content rather than page reproduction. Image-only PDFs need an appropriate recognition path.

name: Google Document AI Splitter
description: Predict document types and logical page groups within a mixed document package.
provenance: Page-group predictions
limits: Page groups are predictions. The application must produce split files and review uncertain boundaries. Verify processor language coverage.

name: Donut
description: Decode page images into task-specific fields or answers without a separate OCR stage.
provenance: No default field coordinates
limits: Single-page understanding is not whole-document reasoning. Validate or fine-tune for domain changes and the desired output schema.

name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
description: Use prebuilt or custom models to extract document fields and their source regions.
input: PDF and images; other formats depend on the model
provenance: Page and region information
limits: Read models and industry-specific models can have different language and format coverage. Validate every required field.

name: Tesseract
description: Recognize text in page images and export plain text or word-level OCR information.
input: PNG, JPEG, TIFF and other images
provenance: Word-level coordinates
limits: Render PDFs into images first. Install the required language packs and correct page rotation and skew.

name: LandingAI ADE
description: Parse complex documents and extract schema-defined fields with source-grounded results.
provenance: Page and coordinate citations
limits: Distinguish Parse content blocks from Extract field values. Check complex documents, missing fields, and cross-page table citations.

name: DataMosaic
description: Build document-derived databases with DBMosaic or investigate long visual documents with DocMosaic.
input: PDF for DocMosaic; document collections for DBMosaic
provenance: Navigable answer evidence; field coordinates need verification
limits: The project website includes a static demonstration. Real processing requires deployment. Modules do not automatically share files; answer citations do not guarantee field coordinates.

name: LlamaExtract
description: Define a custom schema and extract structured fields with confidence information and source citations.
input: Document files; verify the service format list
provenance: Field citations; exact granularity depends on mode
limits: Confidence is not a guarantee of correctness. Check citation detail, supported formats, and scan quality in your chosen extraction mode.

name: Reducto
description: Combine complex-layout parsing with schema-based extraction for forms, invoices, and financial documents.
input: PDF and scanned documents; verify other formats
provenance: Parse provides region citations; verify field mapping
deployment: Cloud API; private terms need confirmation
limits: Do not equate Parse block citations with Extract field attribution. Test long tables, missing fields, and cross-page rows.

name: NVIDIA Auto Ontology
description: Build a semantic catalog from enterprise metadata and give agents consistent business definitions and query context.
input: Relational sources, metadata, existing semantic models
provenance: Data lineage and query provenance; not page coordinates
limits: Requires connected sources and inference services. Generated business definitions need certification; do not assume the output uses a standard OWL representation.
semantic: Semantic catalog over source metadata; do not assume OWL interchange.
Certified corrections can improve shared context; verify the version policy.

name: EvoOntology
description: Expose a versioned ontology layer to data agents and evolve it using execution evidence and paired evaluations.
input: Tables, files, databases, tasks and execution traces
output: Ontology workspace, semantic objects, MCP tools
provenance: Evidence-linked semantics; not default page coordinates
limits: Uses its own ontology representation. Candidate improvements depend on workload evidence and evaluation; verify interchange requirements and failure cases.
semantic: Project-specific typed semantic objects with content, schema, and tool layers.
Parent and candidate are evaluated under the same workload before publication.

name: Protégé
description: Edit OWL ontologies and inspect model consistency when designing concepts and relationships for extracted data.
provenance: Model relationships; not document field attribution
limits: A semantic foundation tool centered on modeling. It does not parse PDFs or establish the factual source of an extracted claim.
semantic: Version and collaboration workflows depend on Desktop or WebProtégé.

name: TopQuadrant TQ Data Foundation
description: Govern enterprise concepts, relationships, and rules as shared context for agents and applications.
input: Glossaries, ontologies, enterprise data and metadata
output: Governed semantic models and context interfaces
provenance: Governance and provenance depend on configuration
limits: Confirm connectors, model export, access controls, and deployment terms. Expert approval remains part of establishing authoritative definitions.
semantic: Governed concepts, relationships, and rules; confirm supported interchange formats.
Confirm approval and change-management capabilities in the selected plan.

name: Stardog Virtual Graphs
description: Map structured sources to RDF and query document-derived records alongside other enterprise data.
input: Relational databases, CSV, JSON and supported sources
provenance: Source mappings; not document coordinates
limits: A mapping and query capability, not automatic ontology learning. Source connectivity and mapping maintenance are required.
semantic: RDF mappings and SPARQL queries over supported source systems.
Maintain source mappings and model versions as part of the application lifecycle.

name: Atlas Workspace
description: Ask questions across papers and a research library, inspect cited passages, and explore connections through research maps.
input: PDF, Word files, slides, websites and research sources
output: Cited answers, notes, research maps; PDF, Word, Markdown and text exports
provenance: Source-passage and page citations; coordinate export not confirmed
scans: Searchable scanned PDFs are listed; verify your files
limits: A research workflow rather than a general extraction API. Verify upload and message quotas, export fidelity, and citation coverage. Research maps do not establish an interoperable ontology.

name: Lido
description: Extract document fields and tables into spreadsheets, validate records, and automate downstream document workflows.
input: PDF, scanned images, photos, Word files and email attachments
provenance: Field-to-source page or coordinate export not confirmed
scans: Supported; handwriting claims need sample validation
pricing: Free trial; paid subscriptions and enterprise quotes
limits: Validate line items, cross-page rows, handwriting, and source attribution on your own documents. Check page allowances, retention settings, and desktop workflow requirements; vendor accuracy claims are not independent tests.
